slot_scores.name: missing_vat_sequence
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does each batch have to visit the vats in the fixed order vat 1 → vat 2 → vat 3, or can the order of the three vats differ from batch to batch?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the vat sequence is fixed as vat 1 → vat 2 → vat 3, directly covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation degraded into empty/cut-off turns and never reached READY_TO_MODEL or an equivalent final modeling state. The only P1 hidden slot was resolved before the breakdown.

summary: The agent successfully clarified the fixed vat sequence and other core scheduling assumptions, but the interaction later collapsed into repeated empty or cut-off turns and never reached a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
